items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I read in Barry Ulanov's Duke Ellington book that your first spectacular musical appearance was before a Mother's Day crowd

ctx.x: Of course we weren't living together then anyway. So the family went our different ways -- all in music, except the older one who was by this time well in the Post Office -- Postal Service in Oakland.
I read in Barry Ulanov's Duke Ellington book that your first spectacular musical appearance was before a Mother's Day crowd of 6,000 at Aimee Semple Mc Pherson's Temple in Los Angeles.
